name: complex-analysis-suite
description: Monorepo for a suite of complex-analysis / complex-dynamics visualization tools that share packages and hand data off to one another.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>

scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=./.vitest-census.json && node scripts/assert-test-census.mjs ./.vitest-census.json
scripts.test:browser: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -C packages/gpu run test:browser && pnpm -C packages/schwarz run test:browser && pnpm -C apps/complex-dynamics run test:browser && pnpm -C apps/quadrature-domains run test:browser
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm dep:check && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run lint && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run lint
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run build && node scripts/check-built-artifacts.mjs
